line: Flat shapes, limited palette, a confident narrator: the 1950s instructional cartoon.
line_cn: 扁平色块、有限配色、沉稳旁白：50 年代的教学动画。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: Flat geometric shapes with paper-print texture; no outlines, overlapping colour fields.
A four-colour palette plus black and off-white, one accent for the thing being taught.
Stylised people: simple heads, long limbs, no faces beyond a dot and a line.
Motion is clean and mechanical; objects slide, rotate and pop on the beat.
not: Not corporate vector motion graphics: there is print texture and misregistration.
Not rubber hose: no bounce, no gags, colour allowed.
Not a UI screencast: no interface chrome.
materials: Screen-print colour fields with slight misregistration and halftone in the shadows.
Shapes cut from paper: hard edges, no gradients.

rules: Four colours plus black and off-white; the accent is reserved for the thing being explained.
Backgrounds are a single flat field; depth by overlap only.
colour.examplePalette: paper #f4efe2, teal #2a8c8c, mustard #e2b13c, brick #c8553d, navy #243a5e, ink #1e1b18

type.titleFont: a geometric sans (Futura-like), bold, on a flat colour block
type.placement: titles as flat colour cards; captions bottom-left on a colour block
rules: Numbers and labels are assembler captions; the model never draws them.
Things arrive by sliding or popping, on the beat.
A diagram builds one element per beat.
The camera rarely moves; the layout does.

grammar.expresses: the diagram; the layout does the work

framing: The accent-coloured thing is never cropped.

foley: a soft pop when a shape appears
a click for a step done
sound.silence: the narrator pauses; the shape sits alone one beat
sound.voice: confident, friendly, mid-century announcer; one sentence per shot
sound.musicDefault: light vibraphone and clarinet, mid-tempo, unobtrusive

nativeMoves.name: Build the diagram
nativeMoves.what: One element pops in per beat until the system is complete.
nativeMoves.build: static shot, up to 6 beats each adding one shape; the caption names each in the assembler.

nativeMoves.name: Slide to the next panel
nativeMoves.what: The whole layout trucks sideways to the next step.
nativeMoves.build: continuous link with camera truck; the next shot's beats start where the slide lands.

nativeMoves.name: The accent swap
nativeMoves.what: Only the taught thing has the accent colour; it moves between objects.
nativeMoves.build: jump_cut with beats 'the brick colour passes from the plug to the socket'.

nativeMoves.name: The simple person
nativeMoves.what: A long-limbed figure demonstrates with one gesture.
nativeMoves.build: character element described as 'flat paper-cut figure, dot eyes'; reference mode.

pitfalls.problem: The model adds gradients and 3D shading.
pitfalls.fix: Say 'flat paper-cut shapes, no gradients, screen-print texture' in the suffix; dof deep.
Keep 'no on-screen text' and add labels in the assembler.
One idea per shot; split the diagram across jump cuts.

look.genre: 1950s mid-century flat instructional cartoon, friendly explainer
look.palette: four flat print colours plus black and off-white paper, one accent for the subject
look.camera: mostly locked; layout slides to the next panel

engine.beatSuffix: Flat mid-century paper-cut shapes with screen-print texture, no gradients, one accent colour.

structures: a wrong way then the right way
a question, three options, one answer
openings: the accent object alone on paper
a title card that slides off to reveal step one
endings: the figure gives a thumbs up
the accent object fades to paper
